articles.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,434
articles.summary: A Russian drone attack on a passenger train in Ukraine's Kharkiv region resulted in at least four fatalities. This incident, occurring on Wednesday, January 28, underscores the persistent conflict and its severe impact on civilian infrastructure and lives in Ukraine. The attack highlights the ongoing humanitarian crisis amidst the geopolitical tensions in the region.

articles.title: Why Cody Bellinger’s $162 million contract will cost Yankees much more than expected
articles.summary: The New York Yankees face intricate financial rules, with Cody Bellinger's projected luxury tax cost in 2026 set to significantly exceed Aaron Judge's. This article highlights complex collective bargaining agreement regulations governing Major League Baseball salaries and team finances. It underscores the substantial economic implications of such rules within professional sports, influencing player valuations.
